topic: Are more colour pigments to discover?
research_conclusion: New pigment materials and useful reflectance signatures remain plausible to discover or engineer. A pigment does not create a new fundamental dimension of normal human colour vision; novelty must be defined relative to a reference library and stated viewing conditions.
